name: Glow-Up Comeback
steps: Tap the burger on the table to change it into a healthy salad.
Tap under the bed to clean all the mess in the room.
Tap the garbage bin to empty and remove all trash.
Tap her clothes to change into a nice red dress.
Tap the bed sheets to make the bed neat and tidy.
Tap the kitten on the wardrobe to feed it.
Tap the laptop to turn off the screen.
Tap the wardrobe doors to close and organize it.
Tap the diary on the bed to write her daily habits.
Tap the ceiling light to switch it off for sleep.
Tap the wand and stars on the floor to collect them.
Drag the bouquet of flowers to the boy to finish the level.
